401680202.text: I don't know... That has never happened before.

401680203.text: Did anyone see her on the way here?

401680204.text: We're here! Huh? What's got you all looking so worried?

401680206.text: Oh, maybe she's just running late?

401680207.text: That's not like her. She's come early every other time we've met. Besides, Cyno went to the Grand Bazaar to meet up with her before the meeting...

401680208.text: But, I was told she had left first thing this morning.

401680209.text: And now, Cyno's here, but Nilou's still nowhere to be found...

401680211.text: Any progress with the robbery case?

401680212.text: We interrogated the people in charge of the caravan on the day of the incident...

401680213.text: But, they were technically the victims of the case, and all their goods were lost, so there was no evidence to investigate.

401680214.text: Their goods are certainly suspicious, but until we recover them, all we can do is to observe the caravan under the guise of protection.

401680215.text: We contacted the original seller of the gem. Apparently, he sold the other half to a young man in the desert, but that's all he could tell us.

401680216.text: So, to summarize — the location of the "hazardous materials" and the second gem are a complete mystery, and now Nilou is missing as well.

401680217.text: Wait, you think Nilou's disappearance is connected to all this?

401680218.text: We're still not sure if the three events are connected, but if they are... It would probably have something to do with Nilou's Dance of Sabzeruz.

401680219.text: The Dance is a key part of the Festival. If someone was trying to sabotage the celebrations, Nilou would be a natural target.

401680221.text: #{NICKNAME}, Candace, there's no time to waste. Let's try to follow her trail.

401680222.text: Tighnari, can you stay back and explain the situation to everyone when they arrive?

401680223.text: Of course. It's still possible Nilou was simply held up by something urgent. I'll wait here.

401680302.text: Oh, hello. Did you need something?

401680303.text: We're looking for Nilou. Do you know where she is?

401680304.text: Nilou? She left bright and early this morning. Said she had to help out a friend.

401680305.text: Was she by herself? And did you happen to see which gate she used to leave the city?

401680306.text: She definitely left alone. As for the direction... I think she left through the gate to the north.

401680307.text: ...So, the complete opposite direction of Pardis Dhyai.

401680308.text: Did something happen? This is no time for practical jokes, you know.

401680309.text: Mr. Zubayr, could you send word to Pardis Dhyai if Nilou comes back to the Grand Bazaar?

401680310.text: Of course. I'm sure she just got caught up in something. Still, let me know when you find her.

401680312.text: Alright, let's leave through the north gate and see what we can find.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask about Nilou's whereabouts along the way

401680401.text: Miss Nevida, have you seen Nilou this morning?

401680402.text: Nilou? Oh, yes! I saw her head out of the city. She was wearing the prettiest outfit...

401680405.text: Was there anyone following her? Did everything look okay?

401680406.text: I mean, it looked like she was in a good mood. She even stopped to say hello. And no... I didn't see anyone else.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask about Nilou's whereabouts along the way

401680501.text: Excuse me, have any of you seen Miss Nilou from Zubayr Theater come this way?

401680502.text: Yes, General. I saw Miss Nilou cross the bridge after leaving the city this morning. There was a man waiting for her on the other side.

401680503.text: Wait, could that be the person who bought the second gem!?

401680504.text: Did you see the man's face?

401680505.text: Unfortunately, no. He was too far away.

401680506.text: ...Understood. If she comes back this way, tell her to find me at Pardis Dhyai.

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the clues to find Nilou

401680601.text: The trail ends here... and there's no one else we can ask for clues.

401680602.text: There are intersecting sets of footprints on the ground. We could try tracking some of them...

401680603.text: With this many traces, it's easy to get mixed up. Let me take a closer look...

401680605.text: Excuse me for a moment, you two.

401680606.text: Sure. We'll continue analyzing the footprints over here.

401680607.text: Tell us right away if you find anything.

401680702.text: ...Eek! It's the nice Golden Nara! Arasaka... must hide!

401680703.text: Huh? Why would you need to hide? We're friends, aren't we?

401680704.text: Friends... Arasaka is friends with the Golden Nara, but... Arapas said Arasaka can't talk to too many people right now.

401680706.text: He thinks Arasaka will let everything slip by accident...

401680707.text: Eek! Arasaka shouldn't say any more!

401680708.text: Let things slip, huh... Okay, we just have one question. Did you see a girl walk by?

401680711.text: A red Nara who's pretty like a padisarah? Yes, Arasaka saw that Nara!

401680712.text: Really? Which way did she go?

401680713.text: She went towards a messy pile of rocks with another Nara, but Arasaka doesn't know them.

401680715.text: Probably the ruins near the Fane of Ashvattha.

401680716.text: Oh! That makes sense. Thank you, Arasaka!

401680717.text: Arasaka is happy to help kind Golden Nara. Kind Golden Nara has helped Arasaka in the past.

401680718.text: Arasaka, about the other thing you mentioned...

401680719.text: Eek! Arasaka doesn't know anything! Arasaka won't say anything else!

401680720.text: Ah...! Guess that ends this conversation...

401680721.text: Well, let's tell Cyno and Candace what we learned.

401680802.text: The footprints lead in that direction as well.

401680803.text: Where did you get this information?

401680804.text: Well, uh... we were tipped off by some friends. We can vouch for the information!

401680806.text: Let's go after them. Hopefully... Ugh! Ah...

401680808.text: Yes... But this time, I only heard faint voices.

401680810.text: It sounded like two people having a conversation... There was someone asking, "will she find out," and something about "following the tracks"...

401680811.text: Was Nilou one of the voices?

401680812.text: I couldn't tell. The voices were too muffled.

401680813.text: Hmm... Let's head towards the ruins for now. The vision could mean we're on the right track.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the places the clues point to

401680902.text: This area is usually full of Treasure Hoarders. Nilou could be in danger...

401680905.text: I don't think she can hear us. We're too far away.

401681001.text: Wow, can't believe we've walked this far already...

401681002.text: We should be getting close, right?

401681005.text: Nilou! We knew there was a bad guy with you! Leave her alone, you... Huh?

401681006.text: Uh, by "bad guy"... Do you mean me?

401681008.text: Am I not supposed to be here?

401681009.text: What are you guys doing here?

401681010.text: Can't we stick to one question at a time? Oh, wait... that one doesn't count...

401681011.text: What dreadful cacophony! Are we not allowed a quiet place to practice?

401681014.text: Ah, Pale Floater! And my Yasnapati!

401681015.text: You know this red floating being?

401681016.text: Excuse you! I, Sorush, am a noble Pari, and the Bloomguard of Khvarena!

401681017.text: Uh... Sorush is a Pari we met in the Vourukasha Oasis. She's really nice. You just have to get used to the way she talks.

401681018.text: Huh? Mr. Sethos, that item on your person...

401681019.text: Oh, you mean this cracked Wedjat Eye?

401681020.text: So, you were the one who bought the other gem!

401681021.text: A Wedjat Eye, Pari... Sounds like something I've read about before...

401681022.text: Then, you can probably guess what really happened.

401681023.text: Now's not the time for riddles. Everyone in the city is still worried about Nilou.

401681024.text: Worried about me? But, I left a message for everyone...

401681026.text: We never received anything like that.

401681027.text: Don't tell me Rashnu fell asleep halfway there... again!

401681028.text: Hearing that name, this is all starting to check out...

401681030.text: The Pari that was supposed to pass on my message. She did look really tired earlier...

401681031.text: Hold on! Let's take this one thing at a time... First, what are you guys doing here?

401681032.text: Well, that explanation starts with the first time I met Sorush.

401681102.text: Hmph! I've had enough of these insufferable rascals! Wreaking havoc in the desert right and left!

401681104.text: Wake up, Rashnu! We need to teach them a lesson, or we'll never get another good night's sleep!

401681107.text: I'll trap them with my thorns when they pass by, and you can take care of the rest.

401681108.text: Perfect! They don't stand a chance!

401681109.text: Let's give them a taste of sheer terror!

401681901.text: (All the preparations are done. Wait until the start of the parade tomorrow?)

401681402.text: They've probably had enough, don't you think?

401681404.text: The name's Sethos. I was out for a walk when I heard the commotion, so I came to check it out.

401681405.text: Since you already destroyed their goods, I'd say you can stop here. These kinds of situations can easily get out of hand.

401681406.text: Brazen youth, have you any idea to whom you speak?

401681407.text: The Bloomguard, Sorush — renowned among the Pari. All children of the desert know your name.

401681408.text: So, you're not entirely ignorant after all... Fine — I'm willing to call it a day.

401681409.text: But if those scoundrels continue to disrupt the peace of this land, I will show no mercy!

401681501.text: The two of us really hit it off after that, so I became her guide in Sumeru City.

401681502.text: You really can get along with anyone, huh...

401681503.text: Sethos fulfilled his duty well. I have come here for a monumental task!

401681505.text: I heard Lesser Lord Kusanali is currently celebrating her birthday in the city. As her familiars, the Pari have decided to bestow upon her a special gift!

401681506.text: As decided by Elder Zurvan, the Bloomguard of the Pari — that would be me — will present the Dance of Sabzeruz to Lesser Lord Kusanali, a tradition passed down over the centuries.

401681507.text: I told Sorush the dancer was already decided, but she insisted on meeting Nilou in person.

401681508.text: Good thing I did! How was I to know the current version is nothing like the original!

401681509.text: Well, there are bound to be changes over the centuries...

401681510.text: I was so excited to see the original version, I begged Miss Sorush to teach me.

401681511.text: It's such a rare opportunity! If I present this special version at the Sabzeruz Festival, I'm sure the Dendro Archon will love it! And all the spectators, too!

401681512.text: I appreciated young Nilou's determination, so I invited her here to practice in peace.

401681514.text: Feels like we've been chasing bad guys for days, but in the end, there were no bad guys at all! It was all for Nahida's surprise!

401681515.text: Hold on, don't forget about the guys with the "fireworks." You still haven't figured out what they were up to.

401681516.text: Wreaking havoc in the desert, trying to turn a profit by illegally excavating ruins and tombs... That's my guess.

401681517.text: That would explain why they chose a remote path away from Aaru Village. They're lucky you didn't catch them in the act...

401681518.text: Heh, a few moments with me, and they'd be begging for their days of baking in the hot sun...

401681519.text: Okay... remind Paimon not to get on Candace's bad side...

401681520.text: By the way, Miss Candace, I noticed you're carrying the other half of the Wedjat Eye.

401681521.text: Oh yeah! What exactly is this thing?

401681522.text: It was a gift from King Deshret to Lesser Lord Kusanali.

401681523.text: (It probably belonged to Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, actually. But, given what happened to Irminsul...)

401681524.text: That's right. So you've read the legend, too.

401681525.text: I only know the basics. I never thought these two gems could be connected to the relic from the legend.

401681526.text: I only bought the gem because it seemed like there was something special about it. The legend didn't come into play until I checked certain texts back at the Temple of Silence.

401681527.text: Legend has it that King Deshret and the Goddess of Flowers, Lady Malikata, both prepared surprise gifts for Lesser Lord Kusanali during the first Sabzeruz Festival.

401681528.text: They scattered candy along a path to lead her toward the site of the banquet.

401681529.text: Eventually, she arrived at a lake, where she heard the sound of music. Lord Al-Ahmar was plucking the strings of an instrument while Lady Malikata performed a beautiful dance.

401681530.text: Together, the two extended their heartfelt wishes to their dear friend, and each bestowed upon her a precious gift...

401681531.text: Lady Malikata gave her the Khvarena to protect the rainforest, and Lord Al-Ahmar gave her the Wedjat Eye to record the moments they shared together.

401681532.text: But, the Wedjat Eye was lost after the cataclysm in Khaenri'ah, buried deep beneath the sands.

401681533.text: And Lesser Lord Kusanali turned the Khvarena into a divine bird, tasked with guarding the border between new birth and death... until the bird shattered into pieces and gave rise to the Pari.

401681534.text: So, Candace actually saw things recorded by the Wedjat Eye!

401681535.text: I was definitely surprised it still has the power to record events after all this time.

401681536.text: Its power seems to only resonate with the people of Al-Ahmar, also know as the descendants of King Deshret.

401681537.text: Despite the damage, it still holds many scenes from the past.

401681538.text: (The faint voices I heard earlier... Could it actually have been Lord Al-Ahmar and the Goddess of Flowers?)

401681539.text: What do you plan to do with the two pieces of the Eye?

401681540.text: If you don't mind, I'd like to place them under the custody of the Temple of Silence.

401681542.text: Technically, the Eye belongs to Lesser Lord Kusanali. Why don't you just give it back?

401681544.text: I'm not sure that would be wise...

401681545.text: Even if she remembers the story, I fear all that remains in this fragmented piece of memory... is grief.

401681546.text: (A record of sad memories... As Nahida's friend, I don't want her to feel sad on her birthday.)

401681547.text: I don't fully understand your reasoning, but if this is the decision of the group, as well as my Yasnapati, then I shall object no further.

401681548.text: Well, are you going to let me teach the girl the Dance of Sabzeruz, or do you intend to drag this on incessantly!?

401681549.text: She's got a point. Now that we know it was all a false alarm, let's go back and tell everyone what happened. They're probably worried.

401681550.text: I'll tell the other matra to keep an eye out for that caravan. If we find any evidence of any misconduct, we won't let them off lightly.

401681551.text: Guess I'll stay here, then. There's a bunch of monsters nearby, so it's always good to have someone stand guard.

401681552.text: Sorry to make you worry, everyone! I'll head back and help once I'm done learning this dance.

401681553.text: Focus! No more distractions! Now, follow along!

401681601.text: You're finally back! I was so worried! I was THIS close to sending some mercs after you!

401681603.text: Nope! It was all just a misunderstanding!

401681604.text: ...That's a relief. I'm glad it's all taken care of.

401681606.text: Well, Kaveh's diagram is done. It looked like he pulled an all-nighter to finish it, so he went home to sleep.

401681607.text: We built the frame of the tower while you were gone.

401681608.text: I think I'll check it over later, though. We were so worried about you all, it was kind of hard to focus...

401681609.text: In any case, there's not much left to do. If we all work together, we'll be done in no time.

401681610.text: Great! We don't have to worry about missing the Parade!

401681611.text: #Speaking of the Parade, could I ask you for a favor, {NICKNAME}?

401681614.text: The Akademiya wants the representatives from each Darshan to nominate someone to serve as the Knight of Flowers for the Parade.

401681615.text: After some discussion, we all agreed you would be the best person for the job. What do you think?

401681617.text: Great! You're the hero of Sumeru and a personal friend of the Dendro Archon. We all thought you were the best candidate.

401681618.text: Make sure you knock it out of the park!

401681620.text: Wait, aren't you also in the Parade this time, Candace? You're... playing the tanbur, right?

401681621.text: Yes. I'm providing the background music for Miss Nilou's dance.

401681622.text: Whoa! Paimon's never heard you play music before!

401681623.text: Heh... If you like it, you're welcome in Aaru Village any time. I'm more than happy to lull you to sleep.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Sanctuary of Surasthana and decorate the Flower Carriage

401681701.text: That should be good! All we need to do now is to wait for the parade tomorrow!

subQuests.subQuestName: Wait for the parade to begin

401681803.text: (Everyone's been avoiding me lately. They're acting squirrely... like they're hiding something.)

401681804.text: (I have to get to the bottom of this after the Parade!)

401681805.text: (But first... birthday celebrations, with delicious candy, a beautiful Flower Carriage, and...)

401681807.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, dear Archon.

401681808.text: ...Time to head out, dear Knight of Flowers!

401682001.text: Here's to a successful birthday surprise!

401682003.text: Hah, I knew it! I knew you had it in you!

401682004.text: Kaveh, you truly are a genius architect!

401682005.text: Um... Madame Faruzan, I think you might have had a little too much to drink...

401682006.text: She hasn't been able to contain her excitement since she saw the candy tower hit the Flower Carriage. I even saw her sneak a few extra drinks just now...

401682007.text: Hey, we all deserve to loosen up once in a while! That's what festivals are for!

401682008.text: By the way, Candace, your playing was amazing out there! How come you've never showed us before?

401682009.text: Oh, it's just something I do in passing. When the night watch is calm, and the stars are out, I like to play a few tunes to pass the time.

401682010.text: You're saying the stars in the sky get to hear you play more than us? No fair...

401682011.text: Honestly, I think Miss Nilou's dancing was the real star of the event.

401682012.text: Wait, when did this become about me...?

401682013.text: I see. So, the Wedjat Eye is now under the custody of the Temple of Silence.

401682014.text: You can borrow it for research, if you want.

401682015.text: No need. Certain objects merely represent a period of history. Once the events they exemplify are brought to light, there's little value in further study.

401682016.text: Huh, I thought you'd at least want to see it. A legendary gem like that is sure to be a wonder to behold. Couldn't hurt to take a look...

401682017.text: I'm not about to make the trip to the Temple of Silence for that. It's too far.

401682018.text: You and your hermit tendencies, I swear...

401682019.text: Although, if someone ever brings it to the Akademiya for appraisal and certification, I wouldn't mind taking a look.

401682020.text: On that topic, I wonder how much it's worth...

401682021.text: I've never really thought about it... It's kind of like an ancient palace, in a way. Not many people are going to break off a piece of the wall and send it for appraisal...

401682022.text: Uh, that actually sounds like something my Darshan would do. I've heard some of the underclassmen have quite the sense of curiosity...

401682023.text: Well, if that does happen, write a report and send it to my office.

401682024.text: Huh? Is that protocol or something?

401682025.text: No. I just like to know when interesting things are brought back to the Akademiya. I might want to check it out...

401682026.text: Why did I even bother asking... I should just keep my mouth shut.

401682027.text: Interesting... You use reports as a sort of alarm clock system...

401682028.text: An alarm! Yes, that's what I heard just now. Dear friends, a critical moment has arrived...

401682029.text: Wait, I didn't hear anything. It's not like Hermanubis would call on you and not me...

401682030.text: It is time... to come together... and play Genius In—

401682031.text: Is that Collei calling me? Sorry, gotta go...

401682032.text: *sigh* Genius Invokation this, and Genius Invokation that... When's Collei gonna give me an excuse to leave...?

401682033.text: Everyone seems to be having a lot of fun.

401682034.text: What about you? Are you having fun?

401682035.text: Yeah! I just know... this will be the most unforgettable birthday I'll ever have!

401682036.text: Great Archon, you have a long life ahead of you. Isn't it too early to draw such a conclusion?

401682037.text: Not at all! Sometimes, a single moment is all it takes to know you'll remember something for the rest of your life!

401682038.text: Your name is Sorush, right? Would you and your friends ever consider coming to live in Sumeru City?

401682039.text: Um... Thank you for your kindness, great Archon, but we Pari have our own duties... And we find the city a bit too noisy.

401682040.text: Is that so? If you spend more time among people, you might start to enjoy the commotion, hehe.

401682041.text: Well, that's also true. I have fond memories of my adventures with Pale Floater and my Yasnapati.

401682042.text: Aw, really? Paimon's happy to hear that!

401682043.text: It felt like this year's Sabzeruz Festival had surprises for everyone!

401682044.text: When you called out the Aranara, Paimon nearly fell out of the sky in shock!

401682045.text: Hehe, I'm glad you liked it! I told them to stay hidden so no one knew what was coming.

401682046.text: No wonder Arasaka was so flustered! He was trying to keep it a secret!

401682047.text: Paimon's sure everyone in Sumeru loved the surprise. It felt like a dream!

401682050.text: Oh, it's nothing. I was just wondering... if this whole thing might be a dream...

401682052.text: Then, we should do our best to remember it!

401682056.text: (That must have been what Al-Ahmar wanted when he gave Rukkhadevata the Wedjat Eye.)

401682057.text: (Even though we don't have anything that powerful, we still have our own way to stop time.)

401682058.text: But... How can we do that?

401682060.text: Alright, everyone, closer together, please! People on the left, make some room!

401682062.text: Ah! Sorry, Madame Faruzan! There's not a lot of space...

401682063.text: Pale Floater! This spot is reserved for the mighty Pari!

401682064.text: #Hmph! Paimon's the only one allowed to float next to {M#him}{F#her}!

401682065.text: So, that's what you meant... A picture! Haha... I never thought about it that way before.

401682201.text: Let's take another look at the Flower Carriage.

401684001.text: You should go. I'll wait here.

401685001.text: Be on your way, now. Don't waste any more time.

401685101.text: Judging by the traces, they must have turned left...

401685102.text: It's easy to get mixed up with this many footprints. We need to be thorough.

401685301.text: Watch closely — one and two and...

401685401.text: You all go ahead. I'll stay here.

401689903.text: Let's start with the Grand Bazaar. We should ask around for clues.

401689905.text: (*sigh*... I hope nothing bad happened to her...)

401689909.text: This area is usually full of Treasure Hoarders. Nilou could be in danger...

401689912.text: I don't think she can hear us. We're too far away.

401689915.text: Careful, Sorush! Don't get too low, or they might see you!

401689916.text: B—Bombs! There are bombs falling from the sky!

401689918.text: Stop panicking! Get the wagon out first!

401689919.text: (The girl's got a knack for this...)

401689920.text: (So this is what the original dance looked like...)

401689921.text: (Wonder what kind of history is preserved within the Eye...)

401689922.text: Phew, we're done! Now, we just have to go to the Sanctuary of Surasthana and hang the decorations on the Flower Carriage!

401689923.text: Wonder what the Sanctuary looks like the night before the Festival... Let's go check it out!
